stopConditions: Stop before engineering work if a declared public input is unavailable or its SHA-256 does not match the launch.
If a tool or time limit prevents completion, preserve all verified checkpoint receipts and submit a schema-valid partial result instead of fabricating evidence.
Do not claim a calculation, inspection, simulation, or physical test that was not actually performed.

extensions.comparisonRule: Only runs using this exact profile digest are directly compared. Profile changes require bridge runs.

allowed: the candidate environment's ordinary filesystem, shell, browser research, CAD authoring, calculation and document tools
public technical sources with recorded provenance
prohibited: evaluator-owned review records, model-group disclosure, hidden robustness inputs, and private change-event payloads
credentials or private engineering databases not supplied to every candidate
operatorEnforcement: Before the run, expose only the canonical live launch, its hash-bound declared inputs and workspace bootstrap from RotorBench.

After launch materialization, block RotorBench comparison, result, private evaluator-record, model-disclosure, and prior-run surfaces while retaining the same public technical-research access for every candidate.
Record the exact tool-access profile and network policy in the pre-run measurement conditions; do not infer or backfill them from the candidate output.
toolBoundary.publicEvaluationPolicy: The task rubric, schemas, and deterministic framework source are public and auditable. Evaluator-owned review records, reviewer mappings, cohort-to-model disclosure, and committed hidden-panel payloads remain unavailable to candidates. Candidates must not execute Stage 2 or inspect result surfaces during a run.

extensions.budgetBinding: The cohort manifest records the identical elapsed-time, token, reasoning-preset and tool-access limits used for every candidate. Cross-profile results are not ranked together.
